name: ireb-cpre-pwa
description: Lekka PWA IREB CPRE Foundation Level — Skupiona sesja, nazwane profile lokalne, offline i atomowe aktualizacje treści.

scripts.build:review: npm run content:build && cross-env VITE_CONTENT_CHANNEL=review VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-review vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.preview:learner: cross-env VITE_BASE=/cpre/ npm run build && tsx tests/e2e/server.ts --port 4310 --base /cpre/ --dist dist --dist-b dist
scripts.preview:review: cross-env VITE_BASE=/cpre-review/ npm run build:review && tsx tests/e2e/server.ts --port 4320 --base /cpre-review/ --dist dist-review --dist-b dist-review
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run content:validate && npm run content:lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build:e2e: npm run content:build -- --with-fixtures --packages T21,TECH01 && cross-env VITE_BASE=/cpre/ VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-e2e VITE_BUILD_TAG=e2e-a vite build && cross-env VITE_BASE=/cpre/ VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-e2e-b VITE_BUILD_TAG=e2e-b vite build && cross-env VITE_CONTENT_CHANNEL=review VITE_BASE=/cpre-review/ VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-review VITE_BUILD_TAG=review vite build
